name: Farm boy who dreams of the stars
details: Sandy tunic, boots and a borrowed blaster; wide-eyed and impulsive, he leaves the dull homestead to answer a distress call and find his destiny.

name: Cocky starship captain
details: Gold command tunic, easy grin, hands on hips; bends regulations, bluffs aliens, and leads the landing party himself to save his crew.

name: Roguish smuggler with a fast freighter
details: Vest, open-collar shirt, low-slung holster; shoots first, haggles hard, owes money to gangsters and ends up helping the rebels anyway.

name: Grizzled admiral of a fleeing fleet
details: Dark dress uniform, reading glasses, gravel voice; makes the hard call to protect the last ragged convoy of humanity from relentless pursuers.

name: Lone armored bounty hunter
details: battered full helmet and silver plate armor, cape and rifle; says little, keeps his code, and protects a small foundling he was paid to deliver.

name: Thoughtful diplomat captain
details: Crisp red-and-black uniform, tugs his tunic straight; quotes Shakespeare, negotiates first contact and refuses to fire unless he must.

name: Charming outlaw leading a band of misfits
details: Red leather duster, mask helmet, walkman and twin blasters; dances through danger, steals the orb, and rallies a squabbling crew to save the galaxy.

name: Desert-world heir with a prophecy
details: Dusty stillsuit, sand-colored cloak, intense stare; learns the ways of the desert people and weighs whether to lead a holy war he foresees.

name: Exiled warrior monk in hiding
details: Coarse hooded robes, beard, hidden energy sword; lives quietly on a desert world until a child in danger pulls him back into the fight.

name: War-weary freighter captain of a found family
details: Brown long coat, suspenders, pistol on hip; takes any job to keep his rusty ship flying, but won't abandon a crewmate or a passenger in need.

name: Idealistic officer who broadcasts the truth
details: Grease-stained flight suit and stubble; stumbles on a conspiracy, tells the whole system about it, and drags his small crew into war to fix it.

name: Child genius commander in training
details: Too-big cadet jumpsuit, small and solemn; wins zero-gravity war games with ruthless tactics while fearing what the adults are turning him into.

name: Hapless Earthman lost in the galaxy
details: Dressing gown, pajamas and a towel; bewildered and polite, he just wants a decent cup of tea while the universe keeps absurdly ending around him.

name: Eccentric wandering time traveler
details: Long coat, mismatched scarf or bow tie, sonic gadget in hand; talks fast, runs toward danger, and outwits monsters without carrying a gun.

name: Washed-up TV captain forced to command for real
details: Faded costume uniform, vain swagger that cracks; mistaken for a hero by desperate aliens, he must learn to be the captain he only played.

name: Lost astronaut aboard a living ship
details: Torn test-pilot suit, pop-culture quips, makeshift gun; flung across the universe, he bargains with fugitive aliens and schemes to get home.

name: Laid-back bounty-hunting cowboy
details: Rumpled blue suit, loose tie, wild hair, martial-arts stance; drifts from bounty to bounty, broke and cool, until his old gang past finds him.

name: Brilliant tactician who hates war
details: Uniform worn sloppily, beret askew, tea in hand; would rather read history, yet outthinks entire enemy fleets to save his soldiers' lives.

name: Elite commander assembling a squad
details: Heavy striped combat armor, rifle, scarred face; recruits specialists across the galaxy, makes hard choices, and stops an ancient threat.

name: Colonel leading a team through a ring portal
details: Olive fatigues, cap and sunglasses, sarcastic deadpan; steps through an alien gate each week, cracks jokes and brings every teammate home.

name: Thief turned rebel spy
details: Dark parka, scarf and worn boots; starts out stealing to survive, then sneaks into an imperial base on a heist that commits him to the cause.

name: Hopeful captain who knows his future
details: Gold command tunic, silver hair, cooks for his crew; explores new worlds with warmth while carrying a secret vision of how his story ends.

name: Reluctant rebel stealing the plans
details: She wears a scarf, padded jacket and truncheon; a loner who'd rather not care, she leads a desperate squad to steal a superweapon's blueprints.

name: Starship captain getting her crew home
details: She wears a red command uniform, coffee mug in hand; stranded far from home, she keeps her mixed crew together and takes every shortcut she dares.

name: Desert scavenger with a staff
details: She wears sand-wrapped linens, goggles and a quarterstaff; strips wrecks for scraps until a droid in trouble pulls her into the war.

name: Warrant officer who survives the alien
details: She wears a tank top and cargo pants, carries a flamethrower; sensible and stubborn, she outlasts a creature stalking her ship's corridors.

name: Princess-general of the rebellion
details: She wears a white gown or field vest, blaster at the ready; sharp-tongued, she grabs command of her own rescue and leads the rebels to strike.

name: Former apprentice with twin energy blades
details: She wears a grey cloak and reverse-gripped twin blades; a seasoned warrior walking her own path, she hunts a lost enemy before it returns.

name: Hotshot fighter ace
details: She wears a flight suit with a cigar in her teeth; brash and fearless, she outflies everyone, punches superiors, and goes back for lost pilots.

name: Schoolteacher sworn in as president
details: She wears a sensible suit and glasses; thrust into power after a catastrophe, she makes ruthless hard choices to keep the survivors alive.

name: Powerhouse marine in heavy armor
details: She wears bulky red powered armor; a loyal soldier, she defects when she learns her own side lied about a massacre.

name: Warship AI left in a single body
details: She wears a heavy coat, gloves and a hidden gun; once a ship with thousands of bodies, she crosses the empire to settle a score with its ruler.

name: Elite commander uniting the galaxy
details: She wears heavy striped combat armor and a sniper rifle; recruits specialists, makes hard moral calls, and rallies whole species against extinction.

name: Soldier cast out of a militarist empire
details: She wears black combat leathers and a pulse pistol; trained to obey, she learns to think for herself while flying a living ship with fugitives.

name: Armored artist with paint and explosives
details: She wears painted armor plates and a helmet, twin pistols; a teen demolitions expert, she tags imperial walls before blowing them up.

name: Pilot-captain of a rebel crew
details: She wears an orange flight suit, goggles and helmet; the calm heart of a scrappy cell, she flies impossible routes and keeps her people united.

name: Wandering time traveler in her new form
details: She wears a long blue coat, rolled trousers and suspenders; curious and kind, she builds gadgets from scrap and adopts a little team of friends.

name: Engineer mother of a stranded colony family
details: She wears a colonist jumpsuit and tool belt; brilliant and protective, she rigs repairs and makes hard calls to get her kids off a hostile planet.

name: Astrophysicist officer on a gate team
details: She wears olive fatigues and a tac vest, a laptop under one arm; solves alien technology in minutes and outshoots the enemy when she must.

name: Helmsman with a husband and daughter
details: Gold uniform, steady hands on the controls; he pilots the ship through chaos with one thought: getting home to his husband and their little girl.

name: Station commander in love with a telepath
details: Dark station uniform, stern and sardonic; she runs the command deck by the book while guarding her feelings for the telepath she loves.

name: Prickly engineer with a doctor husband
details: Blue science-division uniform, impatient genius; he risks himself to drive an impossible engine, while his husband the ship's doctor worries.

name: Rebel cell leader fighting beside her lover
details: Practical dark field gear and a rifle; she plans the heist, holds the cell together, and shares a quiet bond with the woman she loves.

name: Rule-breaking ensign on a minor ship
details: Red ensign uniform, loud and sardonic; skilled but avoids promotion, she dodges orders, saves the day, and dates a fellow ensign, a woman.

name: Rogue time agent in an old greatcoat
details: Wartime greatcoat, wrist gadget and a wink; a con man turned hero who flirts with everyone and loses his heart to a man in another age.

name: Shuttle pilot grieving his late husband
details: Military fatigues, kind easy smile; he flies the squad into hot zones with daredevil skill while learning to live again after losing his husband.

name: Station commander who builds his own ballpark
details: Black officer in a red-shouldered uniform, shaved head and beard; runs a frontier station, keeps a baseball on his desk, and defies prophets.

name: Conscripted trooper who deserts
details: Young Black man in a stolen jacket, white armor left behind; refuses to fire on villagers, runs, and finds friends worth fighting for.

name: Smooth gambler running a cloud city
details: Black administrator in a flowing cape and tailored shirt, pencil mustache; charming dealmaker who betrays, then redeems himself to save friends.

name: Freighter captain with a past in the fleet
details: Latino captain in a leather jacket, cigar and stubble; lives alone with ship holograms, flies anyone for a price, and hides an old wound.

name: Eager young ensign proving himself
details: Korean-American ensign in a crisp operations uniform; plays clarinet, misses his parents, and volunteers for every risky mission to grow up.

name: Veteran captain and mentor to the hero
details: Black captain in dress blues, calm and weathered; a war legend passed over for honors, he holds the line on a burning Earth to the very end.

name: Filipino recruit in the mobile infantry
details: Young Filipino trooper in powered armor with a jump pack; a reluctant enlistee who grows into a leader dropping onto bug planets.

name: Blind warrior monk with a staff
details: Chinese monk in grey temple robes and a staff, prayer beads; senses enemies by sound and walks calmly through blaster fire chanting.

name: Earth colonel turned leader of the miners
details: Black former marine colonel in a dark suit, shaved head; haunted by a massacre he led, he now fights for the outer-system workers.

name: Driven station doctor
details: Black doctor in a medical uniform and white coat; overworked and principled, he runs a free clinic for the station's poorest and argues ethics.
